description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named SoftInputModes, demonstrating how different soft input modes impact window resizing behavior in the Android window management system. It includes UI setup with a Spinner to select resize modes and handlers to apply the selected mode to the window.

classes.name: SoftInputModes
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating different soft input adjustment modes in Android.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the spinner to select and apply window soft input modes.
